name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
June 15, 2009
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Dever
d.
Roll Call
2.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of certificate of appreciation to Rudy Law, guest speaker at the Anti-drug and gang free walk.
Presentation of city plaque to Lomita 2009 Outstanding Older American, Rich Colbary
Presentation of city plaque to Arnold Wolfson for services as Public Safety and Traffic Commissioner August 2004 to May 2009.
Presentation of Certificates of Appointment to newly appointed Tree Commissioner Robert Stemmer, RR Museum Foundation Boardmember Linda Fisk, Public Safety and Traffic Commissioner Moses Chang, Planning Commissioner Jim Gazeley, and RR Museum Boardmember Nancy Borland.
Presentation of inlieu donation to RR Museum Foundation for services of former RR Museum Foundation Boardmember Nancy Borland and Tree Commissioner Moses Chang.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: April 20
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting receipt for equipment donation of a homelite chainsaw to the Community Emergency Response Team (CERT). RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
e.
Report submitting resolution determining that the public convenience and necessity will be served by issuance of an alcoholic beverage control license to sell beer and wine for off-site consumption at 25808 Narbonne Avenue. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
f.
Report recommending approval of comment letter on the draft EIR for a proposed 351,200 square feet medical/office, professional office and light industrial condominium buildings to be developed in two phases at 2740 Lomita Boulevard, Torrance. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Report submitting resolution authorizing destruction of certain public records. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report submitting resolution calling for a general municipal election on November 3, 2009, for the purpose of electing three members to the Lomita City Council and a resolution requesting services of the Los Angeles County Election Department. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report recommending approval of contract with Long Beach Memorial Medical Center for the Lifeline Personal Response System service. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report recommending approval of comment letter on the draft EIR for the Chandler Ranch/Rolling Hills Estates Country Club project. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Report recommending approval of bid to paint the 1902 Mogul and tender using Railroad Museum Foundation funds in the amount of $7,900. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
l.
Report recommending approval of resolution approving the Memorandum of Understanding with the city of Los Angeles as the lead agency for the Justice Assistance Grant (JAG) for 2009. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT ON GENERAL PLAN Public hearing on resolution accepting the 2008 annual progress report on the general plan.
Presented by Comm Dev Drtc Sugano.
7.
PROPOSED BUDGET Public hearing on proposed budget for fiscal year 2009-10 and adoption of resolution adopting the city budget, confirming the factors used for calculating the annual appropriation limit for 2009-10, amending Resolution No 81-56 establishing a compensation plan for employees for fiscal year 2009-10 and adopting a financial investment policy.
Presented by Adm Svcs Drtr Chavez.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
8.
SOLID WASTE FRANCHISE AGREEMENTS Report submitting resolution approving exclusive residential and commercial solid waste franchise agreements between the city and Calmet Services Inc.
Presented by City Mgr Odom.
CLOSED SESSION
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
